shared_elements: horizontal band of rosettes/floral discs framing the scene
human figures in strict profile, walking
large quadruped animal in profile facing the same direction as the figures
human figure leading/controlling an animal by a line or rein
procession moving along a single ground line
justification: Both show a shallow-relief processional frieze: profile human figures on a common ground line leading a large profile quadruped in the same direction, framed by a continuous band of rosette discs along the border — an unusually specific combination of motif, framing and register scheme, rendered with the same conventions of overlapping profile bodies and patterned drapery. The main difference in content is the specific subject: a file of attendants with a two-humped camel versus a wheeled chariot with a driver and harnessed horse.
